verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of hot reload or near-instant preview of game scripts after a change. The nearby items are adjacent: editor plugins can be made "without even reloading the editor", EditorScript can be run from the Script Editor, and one community comment praises fast editor startup. None of these documents a fast edit-run loop for game code.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
